concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-mobilepay-react-native-drop-in]] — 2026-09-15 MobilePay React Native Drop-in Sessions (Checkout API v68+) and Advanced redirect add-on, with experimental `/payments` payout-token guidance, ordinary live-only payment testing and a Sessions prerequisite link that points to Advanced.
warnings: Sessions prerequisite text names Sessions while its URL targets the Advanced base guide.
Payout-token prose uses `enablePayout`; curl annotation uses `enablePayOut`, and other samples omit token fields.
TEST curl and payout test-app instructions do not establish ordinary MobilePay payment support in TEST.
